First, loading all the needed packages.
```{r setup}
library(xcms)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MS1Match)

```




## Data Import and Peak Detection
### Load demo data
We begin by preprocessing LC-MS data using the `xcms` package. The demo dataset `StM16`, included in the `MS1Match` package, will be used to illustrate the workflow.


```{r import-data}
result_StM16 <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "result_StM16.rds", package = "MS1Match"))

```
`result_StM16` is a list with four elements: `result_StM16[[1]]` is a `XCMSnExp` object from `XCMS`, `result_StM16[[2]]` is feature definition table, `result_StM16[[3]]` is the feature intensity  table and `result_StM16[[4]]` is `XChromatograms` object where the information of the extracted ion chromatogram (EIC) is saved.   


```{r}
head(result_StM16[[2]])
```


```{r}
head(result_StM16[[3]])
```


### Prepare the Feature Table

We now create a feature table by combining the output from `result_StM16[[2]]` (feature definitions) and `result_StM16[[3]]` (intensity values). The table is then cleaned and prepared for downstream annotation.

In particular:

1. Convert the result to a data frame (**required**)
2. Rename the first column to `feature_name` (**required**)
3. Remove the `peakidx` column (**optional**)
4. Calculate a new column `intensity_mean` as the row-wise mean across samples (**required** if using multiple samples)
5. Sort the table by RT or m/z (**optional**)
6. Filter by retention time using `dplyr::filter()` (**optional**)  
   – For example, filter features with RT between 60 and 1200 seconds by setting `rt_range = c(60,1200)`.

```{r create-FT}
result_StM16_FT_filtered <- processFeatureTable(result_StM16, sample_cols = "mzxml", sort_by ="rtmed") 

```

```{r}
head(result_StM16_FT_filtered)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Access the correlation data frame
cor_df <- cor_results@correlation_df

# For each unique feature_1, count pairs with similarity > 0.8
high_similarity_summary <- cor_df %>%
  group_by(feature_1) %>%
  summarize(
    total_pairs = n(),
    high_similarity_count = sum(similarity_score > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_similarity_ratio = high_similarity_count / total_pairs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View first few rows
head(high_similarity_summary,30)

# Summary across all feature_1
summary(high_similarity_summary$high_similarity_count)

# Optional: how many feature_1 have *at least one* high similarity pair
features_with_high_sim <- sum(high_similarity_summary$high_similarity_count > 0)
cat("Number of features with at least one high similarity pair:", features_with_high_sim, "\n")

```



### process RT 

Euclidean distance and normalize it with inverse scaling.

```{r}
# extract RT vector 
rt_values <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$rtmed

# calculate rt similarity
rt_sim <- calRTSimilarity(rt_values, sigma = 2, method = "gaussian")
```


```{r}
# Inspect the results
rt_sim@dist_matrix[1:5,1:5]  # Pairwise distances
rt_sim@sim_matrix[1:5,1:5]  # Similarity (0–1 scale)

```
 A heatmap Visualization on small subset features:
```{r}
pheatmap::pheatmap(rt_sim@sim_matrix[1:100,1:100],
                   clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                   clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
                   clustering_method = "ward.D2")

```

```{r}
library(igraph)
threshold <- 0.7
adj_mat <- (rt_sim@sim_matrix[1:1000,1:1000] > threshold) * 1
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected")

plot(g, layout = layout_with_fr, vertex.size = 3, vertex.label = NA,
     main = paste("Graph of Features with Similarity >", threshold))

```
 
```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggplot2)

# Build graph
threshold <- 0.7
adj_mat <- (rt_sim@sim_matrix > threshold) * 1
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected")

# Add metadata to graph
V(g)$name <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$feature_name
V(g)$rtmed <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$rtmed
V(g)$mzmed <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$mzmed

# Compute communities
clusters <- components(g)$membership
V(g)$cluster <- clusters

# Compute mean RT per cluster
mean_rt_by_cluster <- aggregate(V(g)$rtmed, by = list(cluster = clusters), FUN = mean)
colnames(mean_rt_by_cluster) <- c("cluster", "mean_rt")
```


```{r}
library(igraph)
library(plotly)
library(viridis)  # For viridis palette

# Threshold similarity
threshold <- 0.7
adj_mat <- (rt_sim@sim_matrix > threshold) * 1
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected")

# Assign metadata
V(g)$name <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$feature_name
V(g)$rtmed <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$rtmed
V(g)$mzmed <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$mzmed
V(g)$cluster <- igraph::clusters(g)$membership

# Layout
layout_df <- data.frame(
  x = V(g)$rtmed,
  y = jitter(V(g)$cluster, amount = 0.3),
  feature_name = V(g)$name,
  rtmed = V(g)$rtmed,
  mzmed = V(g)$mzmed,
  cluster = V(g)$cluster
)

# Get viridis colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(V(g)$cluster))
cluster_colors <- viridis(n_clusters)

# Calculate cluster sizes
cluster_sizes <- table(V(g)$cluster)

layout_df$cluster_size_raw <- cluster_sizes[as.character(layout_df$cluster)]

cluster_summary <- layout_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    cluster_size = n(),
    mean_rtmed = mean(rtmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rtmed = min(rtmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rtmed = max(rtmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mzmed = mean(mzmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_mzmed = min(mzmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_mzmed = max(mzmed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


layout_df <- layout_df %>%
  left_join(cluster_summary, by = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(y = jitter(cluster, amount = 0.3))

library(plotly)

color_scale <- scales::col_factor(
  palette = rev(viridisLite::viridis(10)),  
  domain = range(layout_df$cluster_size)   
)

p <- plot_ly(
  data = layout_df,
  x = ~x, 
  y = ~y, 
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = ~cluster_size,  
  colors = rev(viridisLite::viridis(10)),  
  text = ~paste0(
  "<b>Cluster Size:</b> ", cluster_size, "<br>",
  "<b>Mean RT (s):</b> ", round(mean_rtmed, 2), " [", round(min_rtmed,2), "-", round(max_rtmed,2), "]<br>",
  "<b>MZ Range:</b> ", round(min_mzmed, 4), " – ", round(max_mzmed, 4), "<br>"

),


  marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.8, line = list(width = 0.5, color = 'black')),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) %>% 
  layout(
    title = "Feature Communities RT Similarity",
    xaxis = list(title = "RT (seconds)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Cluster"),
    showlegend = TRUE
  )

p




```
 
 
 
 
```{r}
library(igraph)
library(visNetwork)

# Threshold for similarity
threshold <- 0.7

# Subset matrix
sim_matrix <- rt_sim@sim_matrix[1:2000, 1:2000]
adj_mat <- (sim_matrix > threshold) * 1

# Create igraph object
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

# Extract info from your filtered dataset
feature_names <- result_StM16_FT_filtered$feature_name[1:2000]
rtmed <- round(result_StM16_FT_filtered$rtmed[1:2000], 2)
mzmed <- round(result_StM16_FT_filtered$mzmed[1:2000], 4)

# Prepare nodes and edges
nodes <- data.frame(
  id = 1:vcount(g),
  label = feature_names,  # Show feature name directly
  title = paste0(
    "<b>Feature:</b> ", feature_names, "<br>",
    "<b>RT:</b> ", rtmed, " sec<br>",
    "<b>m/z:</b> ", mzmed
  ),  # Hover info
  value = degree(g),  # Node size reflects connectivity
  group = clusters(g)$membership  # Color by cluster
)

edges <- as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")

# Interactive graph
visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = TRUE,
    nodesIdSelection = TRUE  # Search by feature name
  ) %>%
  visPhysics(stabilization = TRUE) %>%
  visInteraction(
    dragNodes = TRUE, dragView = TRUE, zoomView = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visEdges(smooth = FALSE) %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 42) %>%
  visLegend()


```
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Principal Component Analysis (PCA) or UMAP
```{r}
library(Matrix)

# Sparsify matrix (set weak similarities to 0)
sparse_sim <- rt_sim@sim_matrix
sparse_sim[sparse_sim < 0.5] <- 0  # Keep only similarities >0.5
sparse_sim <- as(Matrix(sparse_sim, sparse = TRUE), "dgCMatrix")

```



```{r}
# Convert similarity to distance
dist_mat <- 1 - as.matrix(sparse_sim)

# Fill missing values
dist_mat[is.na(dist_mat) | is.infinite(dist_mat)] <- 1  # Max distance

# Run UMAP with dense distance matrix
embedding <- uwot::umap(
  dist_mat,
  metric = "euclidean",  # uwot expects a feature matrix, so we need distances
  n_neighbors = 15
)

plot(embedding, pch = 16)


```
